title: Five-piece drum kit
creator: Innerscene
sourceVersion: No immutable upstream release or commit is published; the downloaded bytes are pinned by SHA-256.
runtimeAdaptation: Reflect Z into application coordinates, reverse triangle winding, group by instrument and response role, merge by material, resample maps to maximum 512 pixels, and align actual surface contacts to PerformancePlan targets with uniform per-instrument scaling. Source throne omitted. Tagged shells/cymbals respond while hardware and pedals stay fixed. Floor-connected stand hardware is vertically fitted about the source contact to reach the floor; drum shells, surfaces, pedals and elevated rack mounts keep their proportions.
